description: This file defines the feature for creating articles in the application, including data models, validation logic, command handlers, and the main creation process involving database interactions.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Data transfer object for article information submitted during creation.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validator for ArticleData ensuring required fields are not null or empty.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Command object encapsulating the article data for the creation request.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator for Command ensuring the article data is valid.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of an article, managing database interactions and business logic.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Main method executed to process the create article command, involving author retrieval, tag processing, and article persistence.
